# CooperBench and Anicca iOS: conflict accounting and deterministic selection

Official gold merge report: 499/652 conflict labels, 153 clean labels including six patch-application failures, 147 clean without failure flags. Flash_10: seven conflict labels, zero flagged failures. This is metadata audit, not native agent evaluation. Actual Anicca iOS cache source compiled with Swift CLI: 10/13 before, 13/13 after deterministic nearest selection and strict time window, PR #959. Xcode/device/merge/release and native CooperBench #753 remain pending.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-ops/pull/754) · [iOS patch](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca-products/pull/959)

Sources: [CooperBench](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.13295), [official dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/CooperBench/cooperbench-dataset).
